left_defects.translation: to be absolved only at the point of death

why: Right repeats the heading word across the break, but Left inverts the death-bed exception and misreads de poenis, which weighs more.
Both render the crossing sentence fully; Left leaves a stray untranslated hypostatice, while Right closes the sentence with a period before the continuing or-clause.
The break falls between two prayers and both render the last and first sentences faithfully.
